results.name: create: empty book → New → fill name, e-mail, phone, birthday, two groups → Save; card links and the .vcf on disk are right
no lost edit: closing the window right after Save (inside the 0.5 s autosave delay) still writes the change
validation and cancel: no name + bad e-mail → two errors announced (role=alert), nothing saved; Esc closes the editor
import + search + persistence: RFC 6350 §8, RFC 2426 §7 and a 2.1 quoted-printable card load; search folds accents and matches phone digits; .vcf import skips a repeated UID; survives reload
keyboard edit, delete and undo: E opens the editor, Enter saves, Delete removes, Undo restores; unknown fields survive the edit
duplicates and merge, birthdays: two cards sharing an e-mail (different case) are grouped and merged without losing a phone; a birthday in 3 days is listed
export: CSV to Files (injection-guarded) and as a download; .vcf download re-imports to the same contacts
Files integration and launcher: a .vcf reached in Files with the keyboard alone (arrows, Space, Enter) opens in Contacts; Contacts is in the launcher
axe-core: list, card, editor (with errors) and duplicates view — no serious/critical WCAG 2.2 AA violations
CSV export reports a real trashed destination refusal without changing the book
compact toolbar wraps and keeps each control inside its visible bounds
import repeated new UID skips the second card and persists only the first
truncated import is refused as a whole without changing the saved book
truncated source book is not editable and its bytes survive
unsafe repeated UID book cannot be edited or overwritten
